# Phase 117's probe of SUMSLP (EDIT/SUM) and MACRO/UPDATE: every input
# file and every case. Written by testdata/sum117/gen.go; read by govax's
# oracle tests.
#
# file NAME [FORMAT]   an input file in [SUM117.IN] (or the directory its
#                      name gives); its records follow, one per "|" line,
#                      with \\, \t, and \xNN escapes, or as a rule
#                      "=lines PREFIX N" (records "PREFIX 1" to "PREFIX N");
#                      FORMAT is FIX n, VFC, or STMLF (variable when absent)
# case ID SECTION      a case; then
#   title TEXT         what it asks
#   pre COMMAND        a DCL line run before it
#   step COMMAND       a DCL line whose $STATUS the log shows
#   data LINE          a line after the step (its SYS$INPUT), escaped
#   post COMMAND       a DCL line run after it
#
# Outputs go to [SUM117.OUT] as ID.OUT (the edited file), ID.LIS (the
# listing), ID.DIF and ID.CMP (ROUNDTRIP), ID.OBJ (MACRO), ID.Kn (a file
# kept from the scratch directory).
#

file SUMA.MAR
|\t.TITLE\tSUMA\tSUMSLP probe module A
|\t.IDENT\t/V1.0/
|\t.PSECT\tDATA,NOEXE,WRT
|VALUE:\t.LONG\t1\t\t; a value
|\t.PSECT\tCODE,EXE,NOWRT
|\t.ENTRY\tSTART,^M<>
|\tMOVL\tVALUE,R0\t; return it
|\tRET
|\t.END\tSTART
file SUMB.MAR
|\t.TITLE\tSUMB\tSUMSLP probe module B
|\t.PSECT\tCODE,EXE,NOWRT
|\t.ENTRY\tSUMB,^M<>
|\tMOVL\t#2,R0
|\tRET
|\t.END
file SUMP.MAR
|\t.MACRO\tLOADIT\tN
|\tMOVL\t#N,R1
|\t.ENDM\tLOADIT
file SUMA.UPD
|-4,4,/; M01/
|VALUE:\t.LONG\t7\t\t; changed by SUMA.UPD
|/
file M02.UPD
|-7
|\tADDL2\t#10,R0\t; inserted by M02
|/
file M03A.UPD
|-4,4
|VALUE:\t.LONG\t3
|/
file M03B.UPD
|-7
|\tINCL\tR0
|/
file M04.UPD
|-7
|\tCLRL\tR1\t; M04
|/
file M05.UPD
|-3
|\t.MACRO\tCLEARIT
|\tCLRL\tR2
|\t.ENDM\tCLEARIT
|/
file M06.UPD
|-6
|\tMOVL\t#1\t; M06, an operand missing
|/
file M10.UPD
|-6,,/;M10 FIRST/
|\tNOP
|-7,7,/;M10 SECOND/
|\tMOVL\tVALUE,R0
|\tINCL\tR0
|/

case H01 HELP
  title HELP EDIT /SUM, every subtopic
  step HELP/NOPROMPT EDIT /SUM...
case H02 HELP
  title HELP SUMSLP, every subtopic
  step HELP/NOPROMPT SUMSLP...
case H03 HELP
  title HELP EDIT, the topic's own text and subtopic list
  step HELP/NOPROMPT EDIT
case H04 HELP
  title HELP MACRO /UPDATE

case C01 COMMAND
  title an update file named without its type (.UPD the default)
  step EDIT/SUM/OUTPUT=SUM$OUT:C01.OUT/LISTING=SUM$OUT:C01.LIS S10.SRC/UPDATE=C01

  step EDIT/SUM/OUTPUT=SUM$OUT:C02.OUT/LISTING=SUM$OUT:C02.LIS S10.SRC/UPDATE

case C06 COMMAND

case C07 COMMAND

  step EDIT/SUM/LISTING=SUM$OUT:C07.LIS S10.SRC/OUTPUT=SUM$OUT:C07.OUT/UPDATE=C01
case C08 COMMAND
  title no /OUTPUT: the output's name (S10.SRC;2, the manual says)
  pre COPY S10.SRC SUM$SCR:
  pre COPY C01.UPD SUM$SCR:
  pre COPY S10.UPD SUM$SCR:
  pre SET DEFAULT SUM$SCR:
  step EDIT/SUM S10.SRC/UPDATE=C01
  post DIRECTORY/SIZE/DATE SUM$SCR:
  post SET DEFAULT SUM$TOP:[SUM117.IN]
  post IF F$SEARCH("SUM$SCR:S10.SRC;2") .NES. "" THEN COPY SUM$SCR:S10.SRC;2 SUM$OUT:C08.K1
  post DELETE SUM$SCR:*.*;*/NOLOG
case C09 COMMAND

  pre COPY C01.UPD SUM$SCR:
  pre COPY S10.UPD SUM$SCR:
  pre SET DEFAULT SUM$SCR:
  step EDIT/SUM/LISTING S10.SRC/UPDATE=C01
  post DIRECTORY/SIZE/DATE SUM$SCR:
  post SET DEFAULT SUM$TOP:[SUM117.IN]

  post IF F$SEARCH("SUM$SCR:S10.SRC;2") .NES. "" THEN COPY SUM$SCR:S10.SRC;2 SUM$OUT:C09.K2

case M01 MACRO
  title the default update file, SUMA.UPD
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M01.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M01.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE
case M02 MACRO
  title a named update file
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M02.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M02.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M02
case M03 MACRO
  title two update files merged
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M03.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M03.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=(M03A,M03B)
case M04 MACRO
  title /UPDATE on the first of a list
  step MACRO SUMA/UPDATE=M04/LIST=SUM$OUT:M04A.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M04A.OBJ,SUMB/LIST=SUM$OUT:M04B.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M04B.OBJ
case M05 MACRO
  title /UPDATE on the first of a concatenation
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M05.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M05.OBJ SUMP/UPDATE=M05+SUMA
case M06 MACRO
  title an update that makes an error
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M06.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M06.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M06
case M07 MACRO
  title a missing update file
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M07.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M07.OBJ SUMB/UPDATE
case M08 MACRO
  title /NOUPDATE after /UPDATE
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M08.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M08.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M02/NOUPDATE
case M09 MACRO
  title /UPDATE with no listing
  step MACRO/NOLIST/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M09.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M02
case M10 MACRO
  title audit trails in the listing
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M10.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M10.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M10
case M11 MACRO
  title /UPDATE after the verb
  step MACRO/UPDATE=M02/LIST=SUM$OUT:M11.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M11.OBJ SUMA
case M12 MACRO
  title the audit trail suppressed and enabled
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M12.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M12.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M12
case M13 MACRO
  title an update file of SUMSLP syntax errors
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M13.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M13.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=Y08
case M14 MACRO
  title /UPDATE with /DEBUG
  step MACRO/DEBUG/LIST=SUM$OUT:M14.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M14.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=M02
case M15 MACRO
  title no /UPDATE: the plain listing beside M02's
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M15.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M15.OBJ SUMA
case M16 MACRO
  title /UPDATE with a missing and a present file
  step MACRO/LIST=SUM$OUT:M16.LIS/OBJECT=SUM$OUT:M16.OBJ SUMA/UPDATE=(NOSUCH,M02)
